in_marathi.name: Anayraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Ananga, divine joy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anayraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anayraj is a Sanskrit name derived from Ananga, which means 'without a body'. It is believed to be the name of a divine entity who embodies pure joy and happiness. In Hindu mythology, Anayraj is often depicted as a manifestation of Lord Vishnu or Lord Krishna, showering blessings upon their devotees.

vedic_reference.note: Anayraj is a Sanskrit name meaning 'No King' or 'Another King'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'An' (meaning 'no') and 'Raj' (meaning 'king'). The name can be seen as a reflection of the idea of being independent and not relying on a king or external authority for guidance and leadership.
